 MONCLOS Expands Global Retail Footprint with Australia Launch at W Cosmetics, Following Entry into Japan and the U.S.
 PR Newswire
02 Nov 2026, 18:30 GMT+10
 MONCLOS launches 10 haircare and bodycare products across 42 W Cosmetics stores in Australia and its online platform 
 Following its expansion into Japan's LOFT and U.S. retail giant Target, MONCLOS accelerates its global growth trajectory 
 Australia's imports of Korean skincare and beauty products rose over 40% YoY, positioning South Korea as its second-largest supplier 
 MONCLOS introduces its signature daily beauty rituals to Australian consumers through a diverse product lineup 
 SEOUL, South Korea , Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- House beauty brand MONCLOS is accelerating its global expansion by launching at W Cosmetics, one of Australia's leading beauty retailers. Through this partnership, MONCLOS has secured nationwide distribution across 42 W Cosmetics brick-and-mortar stores, as well as the retailer's official online platform.
 House beauty brand MONCLOS officially launches at W Cosmetics, a leading Australian beauty retailer 
 Australia is emerging as a key growth engine for K-beauty, driven by rapidly rising demand for Korean cosmetic products. According to global market research firm Statista, Australia's beauty and personal care market is projected to reach approximately USD 6.9 billion in 2026. Data from the World Bank's World Integrated Trade Solution (WITS) shows that Australia's imports of skincare and beauty products from South Korea reached approximately USD 149.9 million in 2025, a 40.2% year-on-year surge. This places South Korea as Australia's second-largest beauty supplier, following the United States.
 W Cosmetics, where MONCLOS products are now available, is a premier K-beauty specialty retailer with an extensive network across Australia and New Zealand. The retailer curates high-performing Asian beauty brands, spanning skincare, makeup, haircare, and bodycare. With flagship locations in high-traffic hubs like Sydney's World Square, Burwood, and Hurstville, as well as an active e-commerce channel, W Cosmetics serves as a destination for regional beauty trends. Through this rollout, MONCLOS aims to build strong local engagement and expand its market presence.
 The Australian debut features a curated selection of 10 MONCLOS SKUs, six haircare and four bodycare items. The haircare lineup includes the Velvet Volume Shampoo , Keratin Bonding Hair Pack Treatment , and Super Silky Essence , while the bodycare offerings feature the Ritual Hand & Body Wash and Comfort Hand Cream . Combining signature fragrances with high-performance formulations, MONCLOS seeks to offer Australian consumers elevated daily self-care rituals.
 The Australian expansion marks another major milestone in MONCLOS' global retail footprint. Building on its successful entry into LOFT, Japan's leading lifestyle retail chain, and its upcoming rollout at Target in the U.S., MONCLOS is extending its reach beyond Asia and North America into Oceania, creating new touchpoints with consumers worldwide.
 A MONCLOS spokesperson commented, "As W Cosmetics is a pivotal retail platform introducing K-beauty trends to Australian consumers, this launch serves as a strategic springboard for MONCLOS to build brand awareness in the region. Following our successful expansion into Japan and the United States, we are thrilled to bring MONCLOS' distinctive haircare and bodycare experiences to Australia. We will continue to expand our presence across major global retail channels to connect with consumers globally."
 About MONCLOS 
MONCLOS is a house beauty brand that brings a sense of self-care into the home, the most intimate of everyday spaces. From textures that feel good to the touch and fragrances that linger in a space to the mood that remains after each use, MONCLOS creates everyday products across hair care, hand and body care, and home fragrance. Rather than pursuing perfection in efficacy or rigid routines, the brand focuses on sensory experiences that people naturally want to return to, encouraging personal rituals that become part of everyday life.
 In Korea, MONCLOS is available offline at its Hannam flagship store, Olive Young, MUSINSA Megastore Seongsu, and MUSINSA Beauty Hongdae. Its products are also available online through the MONCLOS official online store, Olive Young, Naver Brand Store, KakaoTalk Gift, MUSINSA, and Beauty Kurly. For more information, please visit www.monclos.com .
